# The Advantages of Public Transport

Nowadays, public transport is becoming more and more important in our daily life. In my opinion, using public transport have many advantages for people and also for the environment.

First of all, public transport is very cheap comparing to private cars. When you use bus or metro, you don't need to pay for the petrol, parking fees, and the maintenance of car. This is especially good for students and workers who doesn't have much money. They can save a lot of money by taking public transport instead buying a car.

Secondly, it is much better for environment. Private cars produce many pollution and CO2 emissions which is very harmful for our planet. If more people use public transport, there will be less cars on the road, so the air quality will improve and we can reduce the global warming problem. This is very important issue in these days.

Another advantage is that public transport can reduce traffic congestions. In many big cities like London or Tokyo, there are too much cars and the traffic is very terrible. But if people use metro or buses, the roads will be less crowded and everyone can reach to their destination more faster.

Finally, when you travel by public transport, you can relax, read book, or use your phone during the journey. You don't need to concentrate on driving and worry about the traffic.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that public transport has many benefits and government should encourage people to use it more often for better future.
